section.54: The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

54.name_native: The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

hadiths.text: Hudhaifa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Dajjal is blind of left eye with thick hair and there would be a garden and fire with him and his fire would be a garden and his garden would be fire
